title: test(svelte-query/createMutation): rename per-call 'onSuccess' mocks to 'onSuccessMutate' to align with react-query
body:
## 🎯 Changes

Renames the `onSuccess` callbacks passed to `mutate()` in `svelte-query`'s `createMutation` tests to `onSuccessMutate`, the name `react-query`'s tests use for per-call callbacks:

| Before | After | Files |
|---|---|---|
| `perCallOnSuccess` | `onSuccessMutate` | `createMutation.svelte.test.ts`, `PerCallSuccess.svelte` |
| `onSuccessPerCall` | `onSuccessMutate` | `createMutation.svelte.test.ts`, `ConcurrentMutate.svelte` |

The component prop names change accordingly, and Prettier collapses the shortened `<button>` in `PerCallSuccess.svelte` onto one line.

Renames only; no test behavior changes.
